message.content: {"version":"1","chosen":[{"id":"o6","why":"She wants to be seen at a club party; this outfit is bold, uses a dress and set for volume, and the red belt acts as a deliberate high-low break that draws attention to her waist while concealing the belly via dark contrast."},{"id":"o8","why":"A romantic floral maxi answers the 'celebration' intent with soft texture and print interest; adding shoes and a layer fixes the 'dressed' state and anchors the look for dancing."}],"outfits":[{"id":"o6","caption":"Glam black set + red belt statement","pole":"anchor_first|tonal_column|ease_the_knot|break","items":["#215·14","#419·30","#228·19"],"day":"An autumn evening out fits the velvet dress and jersey suit; the red leather belt adds a festive pop without ruining the formal vibe, and the deep tones help conceal the belly while you dance."},{"id":"o8","caption":"Floral print maxi + ballet flats + jacket","pole":"anchor_first|tonal_column|ease_the_knot|break","items":["#158·01","#27·17","#31·13"],"day":"Perfect for a festive dinner and dancing; the floral print gives immediate interest, the black loafers match the dress hem to elongate the leg, and the black t-shirt adds a casual layer that softens the look."}],"needed":[],"break_kind":"bottom"}
